exceptions.reason: A server render with no `hydrate()` runs in Node with no DOM. The case asserts that the server HTML has no `aria-labelledby` on the root and on the input of the thumb. Vase UI has both attributes on the server. The root assumes its label until it is mounted. The thumb defers its render. Its input then has the id of the label, with the label before or after the control. The case "VUE-29: links the label to the root and to the input of each thumb, with the label $name" asserts the server HTML.
